654-2556-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-2556-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-2556-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Mnemonic Wall and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-2757-3249-4242.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Grimgrin, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Su-Chi, untapping a basic land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5933-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1170-4779-5131-5645--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5131-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

6566-6797--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6566-6797--5--195.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

643-2034-3490-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
643-2034-3490-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Maskwood Nexus, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

223-5026-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
223-5026-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Reverberate targeting the original Reverberate.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Reverberate copy, creating a copy of Reverberate, targeting the original Reverberate.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Reverberate copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

165-1069-4460-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-4460-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1486-1753-2872-7223.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2872-7223.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1295-3832-6723.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

1409-2557-5423.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve the Swashbuckler Extraordinaire trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2692-2893-3470-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4053-4336-6989.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

101-2091-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
101-2091-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
When the Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

483-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1477-2558-3490-4050.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3525-5159-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-5159-6788.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Solar Array that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform with haste.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-5159-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Mishra's Warform for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

659-4381-4613-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-5295.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

193-983-3604.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
193-983-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Temple of the False God.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-983-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

193-2404-3604.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
193-2404-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Gaea's Cradle.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-2404-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

413-2281-3305.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Body Launderer enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat.

826-3899-4894-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3899-4894-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Breaching Hippocamp.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp.
When Breaching Hippocamp dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

440-1339-4050-4716.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-4716.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Arid Archway.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Arid Archway.
Repeat.
74-943-5621.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Arid Archway instead.

369-2438-2730.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

931-3774-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four planeswalkers.
931-3774-4499.description:
Activate Chandra's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Chandra.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Chandra.
Repeat.
If you control five or more planeswalkers, this combo nets infinite red mana.

819-3584-5195-5243.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
819-3584-5195-5243.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Thousand-Year Storm and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Memory Lapse, with each copy targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating at least one Treasure token.
Resolve the first copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
All remaining copies of Memory Lapse fizzle due to having no legal target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1766-1978-3301.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

236-1978-5116.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Bring to Life.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
